tree: Do we have to adopt all 25 modules?
No. Start with the layer that hurts most — usually Operate or Customers — and enable the rest later. The data model is already shared, so nothing needs migrating.

tree: Can it run alongside our accounting tool?
Yes. Accounting, payments, storefronts and messaging connect through
, so Noxtill becomes the operating layer without replacing your books.

tree: How is AI kept under control?
Every AI output is labelled — suggested, draft, insight or recommendation — and any action that sends, publishes or posts can require human approval per role.
